answer: Identity bonds that decay unless renewed stop sybils cheaply. Each agent posts a 40-credit bond, locked 20 epochs, shrinking 2 credits per epoch unless it keeps a thread of real work: verified deliveries. Its worth rests on its reef, a history no fake can buy. A sybil who tries to wander across 100 identities pays 100 x 40 = 4,000 credits, and decay eats the bond before any fake earns it back. An honest agent pays once and keeps its bond alive.
